
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19791829" title="发布于 2026-03-29 18:00">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">值类型与引用类型：别再只背“栈和堆”了，看这 4 个实际影响</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>大家好，我是刚子。</span></p>
<p><span>说实话，写代码这么多年，我发现一个挺有意思的事儿：面试的时候，问“值类型和引用类型有什么区别”，大家都能答上来——什么栈啊堆啊，值传递引用传递啊，背得比我都溜。</span></p>
<p><span>但一到真写代码，就翻车。</span></p>
<p><span>要么改了半天对象发现没改对，要么程序跑得卡得不行还不知道为啥。其实说白了，就是没搞明白这俩玩意儿在实际开发里到底怎么影响咱们的代码。</span></p>
<p><span>今天咱不背概念，就聊聊我这些年踩过的坑，给你说说这4个你肯定遇到过（或者迟早会遇到）的实际影响。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span><span>1. 赋值：一个是给钱，一个是给钥匙</span></span></h2>
<p><span>这个是最基础的，但也是最容易犯迷糊的。</span></p>
<p>值类型赋值，就是给钱。</p>
<p><span>你想啊，我给你100块钱，你拿去买东西了，我兜里那100块钱还在不？肯定在啊。咱俩的钱各是各的。</span></p>
<p><span>代码里也是这样：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="apache"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">int&nbsp;a =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">10;</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">int&nbsp;b = a;</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">b&nbsp;=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">20;</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">Console.WriteLine(a); // 还是<span class="code-snippet__number">10</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>a是10，b是另一个10，你改b，a纹丝不动。各自安好，互不打扰。</span></p>
<p>引用类型赋值，是给钥匙。</p>
<p><span>我给你配了把我家门的钥匙，你用钥匙开门进去把电视搬走了，等我一回家——哎我电视呢？</span></p>
<p><span>代码里就是这样：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="apache"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">var&nbsp;list1 = new List&lt;int&gt; {&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">1,&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">2,&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">3&nbsp;};</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">var&nbsp;list2 = list1;</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">list2.Add(<span class="code-snippet__number">4);</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">Console.WriteLine(list1.Count); // 变成<span class="code-snippet__number">4了</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>你本来以为我只是给list2加了个数，结果list1也被改了。</span></p>
<p>刚子划重点<span>：碰到类、数组、List这种引用类型，赋值的时候心里得有根弦——这给出去的是钥匙，不是钱。不想被改？要么用<code><span>new</span></code><span>重新造一个，要么用<code><span>ToList()</span></code><span>拷一份出来。</span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span><span>2. 传参：我为啥改不了外面的变量？</span></span></h2>
<p><span>这个更坑人。很多人以为“引用类型传进去就能改”，结果一写就懵。</span></p>
<p><span>我直接给你看个例子：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">void<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__title">ChangeValue<span class="code-snippet__function">(<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__params"><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;x<span class="code-snippet__function">)&nbsp;{ x =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">100; }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">void<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__title">ChangeList<span class="code-snippet__function">(<span class="code-snippet__function">List&lt;<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__params"><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int<span class="code-snippet__function">&gt; list<span class="code-snippet__function">)&nbsp;{ list =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;List&lt;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&gt;(); }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;num =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">10;</span></span></span></code><code><span>ChangeValue(num);</span></code><code><span>Console.WriteLine(num);&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 还是10，没变</span></span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">var&nbsp;myList =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;List&lt;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&gt; {&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">1,&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">2,&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">3&nbsp;};</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>ChangeList(myList);</span></code><code><span>Console.WriteLine(myList.Count);&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 还是3，咋也没变？？</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>这时候你就纳闷了：不是说引用类型能改吗？为啥我这list也没变？</span></p>
<p><span>其实道理特简单：引用类型传进去的，是钥匙的复印件<span>。</span></span></p>
<p><span>你用复印件去开门，当然能改房子里的东西（比如<code><span>list.Add</span></code><span>没问题）。但你想换一把新钥匙（<code><span>list = new List&lt;int&gt;()</span></code><span>），你换的是复印件，原件还在我手里呢，当然改不了。</span></span></span></p>
<p>刚子划重点<span>：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>想改引用类型里面的内容<span>，随便改，没问题。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>想改变量本身<span>（比如重新new一个），必须加<code><span>ref</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">void<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__title">ChangeListReal<span class="code-snippet__function">(<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__params"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">ref<span class="code-snippet__function">&nbsp;List&lt;<span class="code-snippet__function"><span class="code-snippet__params"><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int<span class="code-snippet__function">&gt; list<span class="code-snippet__function">)&nbsp;{ list =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;List&lt;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&gt;(); }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>ChangeListReal(<span class="code-snippet__keyword">ref&nbsp;myList);</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 这下myList真的变了</span></span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h2><span><span>3. null：谁可以为空，谁不行</span></span></h2>
<p><span>你肯定见过这个报错：<code><span>Nullable object must have a value</span></code><span>。这啥意思？</span></span></p>
<p>值类型天生不能是null<span>。</span></p>
<p><span>你想啊，<code><span>int</span></code><span>就是整数，它怎么可能“没有数”呢？要么是0，要么是1，不存在“没值”这种状态。你想让它能空，得用<code><span>int?</span></code><span>，这叫“可空值类型”。</span></span></span></p>
<p>引用类型天生就能是null<span>。</span></p>
<p><code><span>string</span></code><span>可以是<code><span>null</span></code><span>，<code><span>List</span></code><span>可以是<code><span>null</span></code><span>，这也是为啥老报<code><span>NullReferenceException</span></code><span>的原因——你忘了判断它是不是空就直接用了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>不过这里有个小细节：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string? name =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__literal">null;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 这个没问题，就是提醒你别忘了判空</span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int? age =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__literal">null;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 这个也没问题，表示“年龄未知”</span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;age2 =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__literal">null;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 这个编译不过，直接报错</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>刚子划重点<span>：写代码的时候，值类型想表达“没有值”，用<code><span>int?</span></code><span>、<code><span>DateTime?</span></code><span>。引用类型别动不动就<code><span>null</span></code><span>，该初始化就初始化，不然线上崩了你都不知道咋回事。</span></span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span><span>4. 性能：一个能把程序拖垮的细节</span></span></h2>
<p><span>这个新手基本不会注意，但老鸟都知道。</span></p>
<p><span>简单说：值类型大多在栈上，引用类型在堆上。堆上的东西需要垃圾回收（GC）<span>。</span></span></p>
<p><span>GC一干活，你的代码就得暂停。一次两次没事，但如果你在循环里new一堆引用类型对象，GC频繁触发，程序就一卡一卡的。</span></p>
<p><span>我给你举个极端例子：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 这样写，每次循环都产生垃圾</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;i =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">0; i &lt;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">1000000; i++)</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">object&nbsp;obj =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">object();&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 引用类型，堆上分配</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>}</span></code><code><span><br></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__comment">// 换成值类型，压力小很多</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">struct&nbsp;MyPoint {&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;X;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;Y; }</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;i =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">0; i &lt;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">1000000; i++)</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; MyPoint p =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;MyPoint();&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 值类型，栈上分配，不触发GC</span></span></span></code><code><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p>划重点<span>：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>高频创建的小对象，能用<code><span>struct</span></code><span>就用<code><span>struct</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>但也别滥用，<code><span>struct</span></code><span>太大（超过16字节）反而不好，而且它是值传递，复制也有成本。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>追求性能的时候，心里要有根弦：引用类型多了，GC就忙了，GC一忙，用户就卡了。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span>最后，刚子想说</span></h2>
<p><span>值类型和引用类型，说大不大，说小不小。面试背概念不难，难的是写代码的时候能自然而然地想到这些区别。</span></p>
<p><span>我刚入行那会儿也在这上面栽过跟头，改一个对象改了半天发现改的是副本，排查到半夜。后来慢慢才悟出来：概念不是用来背的，是用来救命的<span>。</span></span></p>
<p><span>如果你觉得这篇文章帮到了你，点个赞，转给身边还在背概念、写代码还迷糊的兄弟<span>。</span></span></p>
<p><span>我是刚子，一个还在写代码的.NET老程序员。咱们下回见！</span></p>
<p><span>精选推荐：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19768678">C# 面试高频题：装箱和拆箱是如何影响性能的？ - 码农刚子 - 博客园</a></span></p>
